## Description
Summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

- [ ] CI/CD or build pipeline enhancement

## Architectural Compliance
- [ ] **Local-First**: Does not transmit private user notes, audio, or PDFs to third-party cloud services.
- [ ] **Design Discipline**: Adheres to the grayscale palette; strictly avoids emojis in UI and docs.
- [ ] **Zero Mock Data**: Does not introduce synthetic filler cards, fake statistics, or mock AI completions.
- [ ] **Cross-Platform**: Verified on the relevant platform(s) (macOS / Windows / Linux).

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Ran `npm run test` (all unit and integration tests pass).
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` (typecheck and production bundle succeed).
- [ ] Verified locally in browser / desktop app.
